text:
maya: heads up — after I bumped samplekit to 1.3.0 the regen CI shows a diff but it looks like only ordering changed in the generated client enums.
regendiff-bot: automated regendiff report attached: https://ci.redwood/regs/1765554322 (summary: 18 files, main drift is stable sort changes) :robot_face:
tj: ugh the semver rule in RELEASE.md says minor bump allowed for new fields but our typegen stable sort should avoid churn. can you paste the snippet?
maya: here — `enum Role { Admin, User, Guest }` used to be Admin/User/Guest and now it's Admin/Guest/User in generated ts. Not from source yaml, looks nondet from our openapi property map.
alex: is this happening only on your machine or CI? flakey ordering usually tied to `Object.keys()` iteration in the generator.
maya: CI only — I ran `yarn regen` locally and got the old order. CI ran in container with node 18.16, local is 20.1.
jen: that explains it. Node versions -> V8 iteration order differences. We should pin gen container or use explicit sort in typegen.
tj: quick mitigation: revert the minor bump PR until we have deterministic output. Also add a regen CI check that fails only if semantic changes (new props) not just ordering.
regendiff-bot: comment: added label `regen-flake` to PR #3421 and posted the diff summary.
maya: I can add a small patch to typegen to sort enum keys by path+name before emitting. will open draft.
alex: thanks. also we should update the release checklist: require `node` version on regen CI image and add a `--stable-sort` flag to codegen.
jen: can we avoid reverting if we force the regen in CI with node 20 to match local? I prefer deterministic generator over being dependent on node version.
tj: agree — long term fix is stable sort. short-term: revert or force regen image. which is faster?
maya: I can do a tiny PR for stable-sort in generator today, but it needs test + regendiff run. might block the release for a day.
jen: OK let's force-regenerate in CI with node 20 for this PR to unblock customers, then follow up with stable-sort patch.
tj: add note to changelog guidance: when bumping minor, run `yarn regen --ci-image=node:20` and attach regendiff link.
alex: filing a follow-up ticket for making regen CI image explicit and adding a flaky-diff classifier so we don't gate on ordering-only diffs.
maya: created PR draft and linked ticket #T-788. I'll force a regen CI run now. :spiral_notepad:
regendiff-bot: CI rerun queued (node:20 image).
maya: rerun passed, diff cleared. re-requesting review on release PR. :tada:
tj: great — hold on merge until stable-sort lands on next sprint, but unblocking this release. thanks all.
